flags.name: output
flags.description: Define exports for build result, e.g. --output type=image,name=docker.io/username/image,push=true

flags.name: progress
flags.description: Set type of progress (auto, plain, tty, rawjson). Use plain to show container output

flags.name: trace
flags.description: Path to trace file. Defaults to no tracing.

flags.name: local
flags.description: Allow build access to the local directory

flags.name: oci-layout
flags.description: Allow build access to the local OCI layout

flags.name: opt
flags.description: Define custom options for frontend, e.g. --opt target=foo --opt build-arg:foo=bar

flags.name: no-cache
flags.description: Disable cache for all the vertices

flags.name: export-cache
flags.description: Export build cache, e.g. --export-cache type=registry,ref=example.com/foo/bar, or --export-cache type=local,dest=path/to/dir

flags.name: import-cache
flags.description: Import build cache, e.g. --import-cache type=registry,ref=example.com/foo/bar, or --import-cache type=local,src=path/to/dir

flags.name: secret
flags.description: Secret value exposed to the build. Format id=secretname,src=filepath

flags.name: allow
flags.description: Allow extra privileged entitlement, e.g. network.host, security.insecure, device

flags.name: ssh
flags.description: Allow forwarding SSH agent or a raw Unix socket to the builder. Format default|<id>[=<socket>[,raw=false]|<key>[,<key>]]

flags.name: metadata-file
flags.description: Output build metadata (e.g., image digest) to a file as JSON

flags.name: source-policy-file
flags.description: Read source policy file from a JSON file

flags.name: proxy-network
flags.description: Run build with proxy network enforcement

flags.name: ref-file
flags.description: Write build ref to a file

flags.name: registry-auth-tlscontext
flags.description: Overwrite TLS configuration when authenticating with registries, e.g. --registry-auth-tlscontext host=https://myserver:2376,insecure=false,ca=/path/to/my/ca.crt,cert=/path/to/my/cert.crt,key=/path/to/my/key.crt

flags.name: debug-json-cache-metrics
flags.description: Where to output json cache metrics, use 'stdout' or 'stderr' for standard (error) output.
